description: Fix RAM crash on T4 by making VisionDescribe and EasyPrompt LLM features optional and disabled by default. When disabled, the script works like the reference T4 script: manual prompts only, no LLM expansion, no Vision model loading.
steps: 1. In Cell 4 Configuration, change LLM_MODEL default to 'disabled', USE_VISION to False, add USE_LLM_PROMPT config and GPU tier comments.
3. In EasyPromptEngine.generate(), add early return when model_size is 'disabled' to skip LLM loading entirely.
4. In InfiniteFlowEngine.__init__(), only create VisionDescribeEngine if use_vision is True.
5. In _process_beat(), wrap Vision Describe call with OOM try/except.
6. Add GPU tier auto-detection warning block in Cell 4.
acceptance_criteria: EasyPromptEngine.generate() returns raw beat when model_size=='disabled'
VisionDescribeEngine is not created when use_vision=False
GPU tier warnings printed for T4 when features are enabled
findings: All _vision_engine usages required null guards since the engine is now conditionally created. Also added OOM try/except around Vision Describe calls for resilience. The USE_LLM_PROMPT flag syncs with LLM_MODEL to ensure disabled state is consistent.
